description: This file contains a PHP class that manages the backend logic for a 'Best Seller' module in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, saving, installing, uninstalling, and reporting on bestseller products within the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: BestSeller
classes.description: Controller class managing the 'Best Seller' module in the OpenCart admin interface. Handles CRUD operations, report generation, installation, and uninstallation functions for the module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main page for the bestseller module settings, including loading language, setting breadcrumbs, and passing data to the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration data via AJAX, validating permissions, and responding with JSON status messages.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs installation routines for the module, such as creating necessary database entries.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Performs cleanup routines when uninstalling the module, such as removing database entries.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays a report page listing the top-selling products.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the report data for top-selling products, with pagination and filtering.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the bestseller counts with actual sales data by updating or deleting entries accordingly.
